hero.headline: Your competitors are in the AI answer. You're not.
hero.subhead: When a patient asks ChatGPT or Perplexity for the best clinic in your city, they get a written answer naming three or four practices. Everyone else isn't ranked low. They're absent.
hero.note: There is no Search Console for AI answers, so most clinics never find out.

problem.heading: What actually happens when someone asks an AI for a recommendation
problem.answer: The engine returns one written answer that names three or four businesses and cites a handful of sources. There is no page two. If your clinic isn't in that set, it does not appear at all — and nothing in your analytics will tell you it happened.

points.title: It's a shortlist, not a ranking
points.body: Ten blue links let you sit at position seven and still get found. An AI answer names a few businesses and stops. Being eleventh and being invisible are the same outcome.

points.title: There's no dashboard
points.body: Google gives you Search Console. AI answers give you nothing — no impressions, no positions, no citation report. Most clinics discover the problem by accident.

points.title: It's usually technical, not reputational
points.body: Excellent practices with strong Google rankings are frequently invisible in AI answers. The causes are normally crawler access, content structure and inconsistent business data.

points.title: Each engine behaves differently
points.body: Run the same question across four engines and the overlap in which sources get cited is roughly 11%. Winning on one tells you very little about the others.

disciplines.heading: Two different jobs get called AI SEO
disciplines.answer: Answer Engine Optimization makes your content the answer an engine extracts and displays. Generative Engine Optimization makes you a source the engine cites when it writes its own answer. They target different surfaces, need different work, and move on different timelines.

comparison.caption: AEO and GEO compared
rows: Featured snippets, People Also Ask, AI Overviews, voice
Extraction — the engine lifts your text
Synthesis — the engine blends sources and you are one

disciplines.closing: Simplest way to hold the difference: AEO wants you to be the answer. GEO wants you to be in the set of sources the answer was built from.

measurement.heading: Why measurement is the whole point
measurement.answer: AI answers are non-deterministic — ask the same question twice and you can get two different answers citing different sources. A single check proves nothing. The only reliable method is a fixed prompt set, run repeatedly under controlled conditions, reported per engine.
method: A fixed set of 40 to 50 prompts, built from the sentences your patients actually type
Three runs per prompt per engine, because the same question does not return the same answer twice
Controlled conditions: logged out, no history, consistent location, same time of week
Two numbers recorded — how often you are named, and how often you are cited with a link
Reported per engine and never averaged, because the engines barely overlap
The same set, the same conditions, every month
measurement.closing: It is deliberately unglamorous. It is also the only way to tell real movement apart from a lucky screenshot.

honesty.heading: What we will not tell you
honesty.answer: That we can guarantee a position. These are non-deterministic systems and no honest vendor can promise you a ranking inside ChatGPT. We sell a rigorous process and transparent measurement of what it produced.

honesty.closing: Month one is plumbing. Months two and three are when citations start. Months three to six are when visibility becomes consistent. Anyone promising faster is selling you something.

audience.heading: Who this is for
audience.answer: Practices where one new patient is worth thousands, competition is local, and patients research heavily before booking. That combination is what makes AI visibility worth paying attention to.
audience.notFor: If a new customer is worth a few hundred, this will not pay for itself and we will tell you so.

finalCta.heading: Find out where you actually stand
finalCta.body: Five prompts against your clinic, run across ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google's AI mode. You get the screenshots and the likely reason. No charge, no obligation.
